notes.title: 14 March v1.3.7 Update. UI Improved.
notes.content:
+General Interface
-The interface in the introduction section has been improved.

-An extra part has been added so that you can select a laboratory in the game entry.

-Improved the in-game interface. It now shows the keys on the screen with which you can access the equipment.

+Specific Interface
-Added an image indicating pressing the "E" key in the titration experiment.

-The interface in the Guides section has been improved. It is now indicated with colors that show which experiments the game supports or does not support, and which experiments can be performed in which areas. It was listed to show which classes it covers.
